newsitem.title: PERU: Peru June inflation paced by food and drink prices.
newsitem.headline: Peru June inflation paced by food and drink prices.

text.p: Peruvian food and drink prices in June rose 1.6 percent, more than any other sector of the economy, which showed 1.09 percent inflation overall, the government's statistics agency said Tuesday.
The sector with the least inflation was rent and fuel, where prices were static last month.

Among other sectors measured by the National Institute for Statistics and Information (INEI), transport and communications prices rose 1.1 percent, furniture and domestic goods were up 0.9 percent, health services 0.7 percent, other goods and services 0.5 percent, clothes and shoes 0.3 percent, and education and recreation 0.2 percent.
The institute said Peru's annualized inflation rate in the first six months of 1997 was 9.48 percent.
